supplements.title: An enzyme-triggered fuse-like microcapsule for encapsulating probiotics: the treatment of ulcerative colitis.
supplements.summary: A specially designed microcapsule that protects and delivers probiotics successfully reduces inflammation and improves intestinal health in ulcerative colitis.

supplements.title: Natural killer cell nano-engagers drive ferroptosis-immunomodulation synergy via inhibition of the Interleukin-6-JAK2-STAT3 Axis.
supplements.summary: A nanoplatform enhances natural killer cell recruitment and activation in tumors, triggering cell death and immune response through ferroptosis and oxidative stress.

supplements.title: Er-Chen decoction alleviates spermatogenic dysfunction in obese mice by tuning the SIRT1/p53 axis.
supplements.summary: Er-Chen decoction helps restore fertility in obese mice by regulating a key cellular pathway involved in sperm production.

supplements.title: Smart nanoparticle delivery systems for curcumin: a targeted strategy to enhance anticancer efficacy and bioavailability.
supplements.summary: Nanoparticle delivery systems significantly improve curcumin's anticancer effectiveness by enhancing its solubility and targeted tumor accumulation across multiple cancer types.

supplements.title: Preventive effects of sea cucumber-derived fucoidan on Helicobacter pylori-induced gastritis: a mechanistic investigation based on regulation of the gut microbiota and metabolic products.
supplements.summary: Sea cucumber-derived fucoidan effectively reduces Helicobacter pylori infection and gastritis by modulating gut bacteria, suppressing inflammation, and protecting gastric mucosa.

supplements.title: Protective Effect of Red Yeast Rice on Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors-Related Atherosclerotic Progression Through Inhibiting Macrophage Inflammatory Response and T Lymphocytes Infiltration.
supplements.summary: Red Yeast Rice mitigates immune checkpoint inhibitor-induced atherosclerosis by reducing inflammation and immune cell infiltration in experimental cancer models.

supplements.title: Phytol Suppresses Androgen Receptor Nuclear Localization and Doubles Survival in Nude Mice Bearing Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer Xenografts.
supplements.summary: Phytol from dandelion disrupts androgen receptor movement in prostate cancer cells, significantly reducing tumor growth and doubling survival in mouse models.

supplements.title: Morusinol exerts anti-glioma activity by targeting the PI3K/AKT/mTOR signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Morusinol, a natural compound from Morus alba, effectively inhibits glioma cell growth by blocking a key cellular signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Association of 25-hydroxyvitamin D levels and vitamin D receptor gene polymorphisms with breast cancer risk in Bangladeshi women.
supplements.summary: Two specific vitamin D receptor gene variations and low vitamin D levels were associated with increased breast cancer risk in Bangladeshi women.

supplements.title: 6-Methoxydihydrosanguinarine synergizes with cisplatin to enhance lung cancer cell death via ROS-mediated autophagy, ER stress, and JNK activation.
supplements.summary: 6-Methoxydihydrosanguinarine boosts cisplatin's effectiveness in killing lung cancer cells by increasing reactive oxygen species and triggering cell-death pathways.

supplements.title: Effects of hydrophobic chain lengths on the structure and properties of polymeric micelles: experimental and simulation studies.
supplements.summary: By adjusting hydrophobic chain lengths, researchers developed micelle drug carriers that optimize drug loading and release for potential cancer treatment delivery.

supplements.title: Advances in molecular mechanisms of anti-tumor bioactive constituents from Astragalus membranaceus: A comprehensive review.
supplements.summary: Astragalus membranaceus, a natural herb, shows promising anti-tumor effects across multiple cancer types by targeting key molecular mechanisms that inhibit cancer development.

supplements.title: Mycotoxins, gut microbiota alterations and liver disease in animals: A scoping review.
supplements.summary: Mycotoxins in food can alter gut bacteria and liver health in animals, potentially causing inflammation and oxidative stress across multiple species.

supplements.title: Tissue-specific distribution of cytotoxic triterpene saponins in three Red Sea sea cucumbers.
supplements.summary: Visceral extract from Holothuria impatiens sea cucumber showed potent cytotoxicity against cancer cells, with triterpene compounds bivittosides C and D targeting key cancer-related proteins.

supplements.title: Phytic acid (InsP6) activates HDAC3 epigenetic axis to maintain intestinal barrier function.
supplements.summary: Phytic acid activates HDAC3 to maintain intestinal barrier function, potentially offering a therapeutic approach for inflammatory bowel disease.

off_label.title: Repurposing Itraconazole for Secondary Prevention of Metaplasia and Primary Prevention of Cancer in Patients With High-Risk Barrett's Esophagus in Combination With Ablation
off_label.summary: Itraconazole combined with ablation therapy shows promise for preventing esophageal cancer progression in patients with high-risk Barrett's esophagus.

off_label.title: Obeticholic Acid for Prevention in Barrett's Esophagus
off_label.summary: Obeticholic acid may prevent progression of Barrett's esophagus by reducing bile acid damage and inflammation in esophageal tissue.

off_label.title: Empagliflozin protects against doxorubicin-induced arrhythmia by AMPK/mTOR-mediated autophagy in cardiomyocyte.
off_label.summary: Empagliflozin reduces heart rhythm disruptions caused by chemotherapy drug doxorubicin by promoting cellular self-cleaning processes in heart muscle cells.

off_label.title: Arachidonic acid-functionalized micelle induces ferroptosis of tumor cells to overcome chemotherapy resistance for breast cancer therapy.
off_label.summary: An arachidonic acid-functionalized micelle loaded with doxorubicin triggers ferroptosis to enhance breast cancer treatment and overcome chemotherapy drug resistance.

off_label.title: An intelligent responsive ZIF-8 co-delivery nanoplatform with multimodal synergistic technologies for closed-loop therapy of tumors.
off_label.summary: A novel nanoplatform combines multiple cancer therapies (photothermal, chemodynamic, starving, and chemotherapy) to improve tumor targeting and treatment effectiveness.

off_label.title: Metformin induces ferroptosis associated with lipidomic remodeling in AML.
off_label.summary: Metformin induces ferroptosis in acute myeloid leukemia cells by disrupting lipid metabolism, particularly in IDH2- and FLT3-mutant samples.

off_label.title: FASN Inhibition Enhances the Efficacy of Chemotherapy in Colorectal Cancer by Inhibiting the DNA Damage Response.
off_label.summary: FASN inhibition in colorectal cancer enhances chemotherapy effectiveness by disrupting DNA damage repair and increasing cancer cell death.

off_label.title: Statins in Gastroenterology: Mechanisms, Human Evidence, and Safety.
off_label.summary: Statins show potential to slow disease progression and reduce complications in various liver and gastrointestinal conditions, with minimal side effects.

off_label.title: Citalopram exhibits immune-dependent anti-tumor effects by modulating C5aR1+ TAMs.
off_label.summary: Citalopram targets C5aR1 on tumor-associated macrophages in hepatocellular carcinoma, enhancing immune response and anti-tumor activity.

off_label.title: Cell Therapies and Bispecific Engagers: Redefining Strategies Against Checkpoint Resistance.
off_label.summary: Cell therapies and bispecific engagers show promise in overcoming immune checkpoint inhibitor resistance by redirecting immune cells and enhancing tumor targeting in solid tumors.

off_label.title: Dose optimization of lymph node-targeted cyclosporine-A for lupus-driven vasculopathy.
off_label.summary: Researchers developed a targeted nanoparticle delivery of cyclosporine A that optimally suppresses immune activation in lupus at a 10 mg/kg dose, reducing inflammation and kidney injury.

off_label.title: Modulating tumor mechanics and vascular barriers to enhance chemotherapy efficacy in pancreatic tumors and melanoma.
off_label.summary: Combining ketotifen, sonopermeation, and chemotherapy enhanced drug delivery and suppressed tumor growth, especially in pancreatic cancer by reducing stiffness and improving immune response.

off_label.title: Enhancing nanomedicine efficacy in KPC pancreatic tumors through ketotifen-mediated tumor microenvironment remodeling.
off_label.summary: Ketotifen enhances liposomal drug delivery and anti-tumor effectiveness in pancreatic cancer by softening tumor tissue and improving drug penetration.

off_label.title: The impact of statin use on colorectal cancer prognosis: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
off_label.summary:
Here's a concise summary sentence:

Statins may improve survival rates for patients with colorectal cancer, though existing research shows mixed and inconclusive results.

off_label.title: Single institution assessment of physician compliance and patient uptake with guideline directed aspirin therapy in the prevention of colorectal cancer in lynch syndrome.
off_label.summary: In Lynch syndrome patients, 58.5% followed aspirin therapy guidelines to reduce colorectal cancer risk, with older patients more likely to comply.

biomarkers.title: Adverse karyotype amplifies risk in secondary acute myeloid leukemia (AML) and AML with myelodysplasia-related changes.
biomarkers.summary: Patients with secondary acute myeloid leukemia and AML-MRC have worse outcomes, particularly when they have unfavorable chromosomal changes.

biomarkers.title: Single-cell transcriptome revealed the aberrant keratinocytes activation in antigen presentation in atopic dermatitis.
biomarkers.summary: Single-cell analysis uncovered how keratinocytes in atopic dermatitis abnormally present antigens, potentially explaining skin inflammation mechanisms.

biomarkers.title: Trimethylated H3K4 and Acetylated H3K14 Expression as Prognostic Markers in Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: In oral squamous cell carcinoma, high levels of H3K14ac and H3K4me3 are associated with increased metastasis risk and lower patient survival.

biomarkers.title: N-homocysteinylation of ferritin and associated changes in iron metabolism as potential drivers of vascular endothelial dysfunction in hyperhomocysteinemia.
biomarkers.summary: Homocysteine thiolactone disrupts iron metabolism in blood vessel cells by modifying ferritin, potentially causing cellular damage through altered iron handling.

biomarkers.title: Novel MicroRNA biomarkers revealed in the serum and bile of thioacetamide induced cholangiocarcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified three specific microRNAs in bile and serum that could serve as early biomarkers for cholangiocarcinoma, potentially improving cancer detection.

biomarkers.title: A stress granule-associated RNA-binding protein FAM120A drives cisplatin resistance in non-small cell lung cancer.
biomarkers.summary: FAM120A, an RNA-binding protein in stress granules, promotes cisplatin resistance in non-small cell lung cancer by stabilizing the MALAT1 long noncoding RNA.

biomarkers.title: Clinical glycoproteomics in cancer: toward tissue-based glycoform profiling and biomarker discovery.
biomarkers.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary sentence:

Researchers used advanced protein analysis to map glycosylation changes in LAMP1 protein across breast cancer tissue samples, revealing potential new diagnostic insights.

biomarkers.title: Digitized Canine Olfaction and Multimodal Biosensing for Breath-Based Multi-Cancer Detection: A Hypothesis-Driven Perspective.
biomarkers.summary: Dogs' brain signals and behavioral responses can be digitally analyzed to detect multiple cancers non-invasively through breath volatile organic compounds (VOCs).

biomarkers.title: Down-regulation of M6A demethylase ALKBH5 facilitates morphine tolerance via SGK1 in mice.
biomarkers.summary: In a mouse study, reducing the ALKBH5 enzyme increased morphine tolerance through a specific cellular mechanism involving the SGK1 protein.

biomarkers.title: Metal Element-Doped Prussian Blue Enhanced Chemodynamic Therapy and Imaging of Breast Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Metal-doped Prussian blue nanoparticles effectively generate cell-killing radicals and provide dual imaging for enhanced breast cancer treatment.

biomarkers.title: Impact of Abiraterone Therapeutic Drug Monitoring on Cortisol as a Surrogate Biomarker of CYP17 Inhibition in Metastatic Prostate Cancer Treatment.
biomarkers.summary:
Here's a concise summary sentence:

Therapeutic drug monitoring of abiraterone in metastatic prostate cancer patients helps track cortisol levels as a marker of effective androgen suppression.

biomarkers.title: Endogenous-Activatable Nanotheranostic Platform for Multimodal Bioimaging-Guided Photodynamic and Gas Synergistic Cancer Therapy.
biomarkers.summary: A multifunctional nanoplatform using gold nanoclusters and l-Arginine precisely targets cancer cells, enables imaging, and synergistically destroys tumors through photodynamic and nitric oxide therapy.

biomarkers.title: Dynamic feedback control of oncogenic tyrosine kinase signaling in acute leukemia.
biomarkers.summary: In acute leukemia, targeting CD25 disrupts a key signaling feedback loop, reducing cancer cell survival and potentially offering a new treatment approach.

biomarkers.title: Stabilization of IQGAP1 by the mTORC2 component PRR5 mediates mitogenic LINC01133-to-ERK signaling in triple-negative breast cancer.
biomarkers.summary: In triple-negative breast cancer, LINC01133 increases PRR5, which stabilizes IQGAP1 and promotes ERK signaling, suggesting a potential new therapeutic target.

biomarkers.title: Genomic and immune landscape of recurrent and/or metastatic squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck progressing on anti-PD1 treatment.
biomarkers.summary: In head and neck cancer, B2M protein expression correlates with increased T cell infiltration and improved survival after anti-PD1 immunotherapy.

trials.summary: Patients with secondary acute myeloid leukemia and AML-MRC have worse outcomes, particularly when they have unfavorable chromosomal changes.

trials.title: Development of Novel PROTAC RAD51 Degraders as Enhancers of DNA Damage Response for Hepatocellular Carcinoma Treatment.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a new drug that targets and destroys RAD51 protein, effectively disrupting DNA repair in liver cancer cells and enhancing treatment sensitivity.

trials.title: Water Confinement in Hollow Fe-TA Nanoparticles Synergistically Enhances Photothermal-MRI Theranostics.
trials.summary: Hollow iron-tannic acid nanoparticles use confined water to enhance cancer treatment, improving heat transfer, drug delivery, and imaging for effective tumor eradication.

trials.title: Exploring the crosstalk between the FGF/FGFR pathway and tumor microenvironment in clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
trials.summary: Lenvatinib inhibited tumor-associated macrophage infiltration in clear cell renal cell carcinoma by targeting the fibroblast growth factor receptor pathway.
